name: action-card
title: ActionCard
description: A question put to THIS reader, answered on the spot: the ask, the context it needs, the answers, and — once given — the outcome in place of them. Reach for <Alert> when the card only informs, and for a plain <Card> when the decision really happens on another screen. Copy: the title is the question put to THIS reader, phrased as a question. The body carries only what the answer needs; anything else
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/ActionCard.json
